label: Each actual bearer whose esse is its essence has no actual cause of its esse
paraphrase: Analyst formulation, attribution deferred. On the fixed q3a4 profile, if x is in act as to esse and its represented esse equals its represented essence, then no c is an ActualEsseCause of x. This excludes all distinct actual bearers as causes of its actual esse in the profile's tenseless, mode-unspecified sense. The implication asserts no identity witness, common source, or modal necessity.
